This is a placeholder for test images.

For actual testing with real images, you can:
1. Add PNG/JPG screenshots to this directory
2. Use base64-encoded test images
3. Generate small test images programmatically

Example test images to add:
- sample-screenshot.png (Mobile app screenshot)
- test-dashboard.png (Dashboard view)
- error-screen.png (Error message screenshot)
- ui-mockup.png (UI design mockup)

The tests will use these images to validate vision analysis functionality.
